title: What If You Jumped Through the Earth?

lines.text: Rusty dug a tunnel straight through the Earth, and jumped in.
If there's no air inside, gravity pulls him faster and faster.
At the center, he's flying at twenty eight thousand kilometers per hour.
It's about five thousand degrees down here, almost as hot as the surface of the Sun.
And right at the center, gravity is zero.
The Earth pulls on him equally from every side.
Then gravity starts slowing him down.
Forty two minutes after jumping, he pops out on the other side of the planet.
If nobody grabs him, he falls back, and swings back and forth, forever.
